# Pinned NVorbis decoder

Source: https://github.com/NVorbis/NVorbis at `v0.10.5`, commit `519d4e2aae7d6a4d5bab552ec5c1e517e9c78855`.

Selected managed decoder sources compile internally into Electron2D.dll. Namespace, top-level visibility and diagnostic changes keep the dependency internal. Mapping.cs groups channels by submap ID and propagates coupling energy for residue decoding without altering decoded floors. Residue0.cs skips inactive channels for types 0 and 1. Residue2.cs decodes a single interleaved vector using the size and scalar offset of the current channel bundle. StreamDecoder.cs rejects identification and comment headers with a missing or zero framing bit and setup headers with a nonzero time-domain transform. These adaptations follow [Vorbis I](https://www.xiph.org/vorbis/doc/Vorbis_I_spec.html) sections 4.2.2, 4.2.4, 4.3, 5.2.1 and 8.6. The retained libvorbisfile PCM tests cover stereo and six-channel Vorbis. The manifest records pristine upstream source digests and LF-normalized digests of the patched local sources. Native/NAudio adapters and test projects are not included. Source digests and archive pin are retained in manifest.json; the original MIT license is retained here and under licence/.
